## Slice 2 ticket 9 of 40, phase notes: paths use `conversation/` (the workspace as it is on develop). Design source: `git show origin/docs/typescript-control-plane:docs/TYPESCRIPT_CONTROL_PLANE.md` (section 8, row 9); read sections 0.3, 2, 3 and 6 as needed. Read AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md first. Never read or write `project/`; use `kbs` only.

## Goal
Port invitations, the organization creation caps, signup mode, and the routes GET /me, POST /organizations and POST /orgs/{tenant}/invitations.

## Kind
mechanical-port: the Python source below is the specification. Keep its structure, names (camelCase), branches and messages. Do not redesign anything.

## Branch and commit
```text
git fetch origin
git switch -c ts/09-invitations-creation-caps-signup-mode-me origin/develop
...work, then...
git add <only the files listed under Files>
git commit -m "feat(conversation): invitations, creation caps, signup mode, /me and create org

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
git push -u origin ts/09-invitations-creation-caps-signup-mode-me
```
Do NOT open a pull request; the orchestrator opens it. Commit messages contain no emojis.

## Exported interface and error behavior
Routes: `GET /api/me`, `POST /api/organizations`, `POST /api/orgs/{tenant}/invitations`, registered through `declareRoute` with audience `user`. Response bodies and status codes are exactly those of the Python handlers at the cited lines. Each Python exception becomes the same-named DomainError subclass.

General rules: TypeScript ESM, `.ts` import suffixes as in conversation/src/storage/; tabs for indentation as in existing files; long clear names; no line comments; TSDoc on exported symbols; no emojis. Each Python exception class used by a ported function becomes an exported `Error` subclass with the same name and the same message text. Failures are thrown, never returned as magic values, unless the Python returned them.

Rule: mechanical ports keep the Python file's structure and cite the Python line range in the commit body. Behavior that no scenario encodes is still kept.
